items.title: Tim Kelly Interview, 1979-03-26
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Did you know Avery Loposa from Mobile? [INTERVIEWEE] This, I think he probably was in this group.

ctx.x: And, uh, and one of the Riddicks, of course I knew Jeff through his affiliation with Wildlands and the Warriors, and I knew him more so as a player. Yeah. He's, he's a good, well-routined New Orleans piano player.
Did you know Avery Loposa from Mobile?
This, I think he probably was in this group.
